sources.title: SecsMurphyAI on DeviantArt
sources.snippet: Founded in 2000, DeviantArt is the largest online community for artists and art lovers, with over 100 million registered members worldwide and hosting over 650 million pieces of art on the platform. DeviantArt empowers creators to monetize their work and sell their art online, and in 2025 tens of thousands of artists sold on DeviantArt for over $23 Million.
